title: Sharp Thresholds for Distance Patterns in Random Subsets of $\mathbb Z^d$
summary: Let $d \geq 5$, $0 < γ< d - 2$, and $Ω_N$ be the binomial random subset of $Q_N = [-N,N]^d \cap \mathbb Z^d$ with retention probability $p_N = N^{-γ}$. We prove that, with failure probability of optimal exponential order, every subset $B \subseteq Ω_N$ of fixed positive relative density realizes, at each scale $p_N^{-2/(d - 2)} \lesssim λ\lesssim N^2$, a squared distance of the form $q^2 λ$, where $q$ belongs to a fixed finite set depending only on the dimension and the density.
